content: Next.js test pyramid 2026: Vitest for pure functions/schemas/sync components/validation + server action logic via direct invocation with mocked request-scoped modules; Playwright E2E for async Server Components, auth flows, full workflows. Async Server Components CANNOT be unit-rendered (Vitest throws — by design). Integration tests vs real test DB (docker compose Postgres, prisma migrate deploy, TEST_DATABASE_URL) are the highest-value middle layer — catches schema/constraint bugs mocks can't. E2E: never mock server actions (server is the boundary), fresh browser contexts, role-based selectors, test against production build not next dev. Four-branch matrix per protected action: anonymous/invalid input/wrong owner/admin. Don't test implementation (did fetch get called) — test behavior (rendered output).
